event.text: Call 911 now — do not drive yourself. Your tongue and lip swelling, throat tightness and hives starting minutes after shrimp could be a severe allergic reaction that can worsen quickly. Stay with someone, and tell the dispatcher about the swelling and throat tightness so they can guide you while help is on the way.
